A1.justification: Both PDFs describe the same work, Learning Partial Graph Matching via Optimal Partial Transport. Their complete main texts, equations, figures, tables, and Appendices A–B are readable and support a reliable comparison.

before.justification: v5 reports original OPGM and OPGM-rs experiments on image keypoint matching and PPI networks, including sensitivity, runtime, and failure-mode analyses in Section 8 and Appendix B.

after.justification: v8 retains these original experiments and reports revised numerical outcomes in Tables 1–4 and Figures 2–3.

M1.justification: Section 7 changes the matching-bias calculation: affinities are clipped at zero before taking maxima, sigmoid(w_rs r) becomes 2(sigmoid(w_rs r) − 0.5), and w_rs is constrained to be nonnegative. This alters the existing bias component; the transport objective, assignment solver, network framework, and loss definitions remain unchanged.

E1.justification: Both versions evaluate Pascal VOC Keypoint, SPair-71K, IMCPT 50/100, and yeast PPI matching with the same five noise levels. No dataset, task, domain, or test scenario is added or removed.

E2.justification: Tables 1–3 retain NGM-v2 with dummy, AFAT-U, or AFAT-I handling and GCAN with ILP, AFAT-U, or AFAT-I handling. Table 4 retains SIGMA and StableGM. The runtime comparator set is also unchanged.

E3.justification: The reported VGG16/GCAN image setup, five-layer GIN PPI setup, evaluation metrics, hyperparameter searches, training budgets, and 3,000-pair timing protocol remain unchanged. No revised split, sample size, or testing procedure is documented.

E4.justification: The existing learned-bias comparison, noise robustness study, and rho/lambda sensitivity analyses receive updated OPGM-rs outcomes. Figure 3 also revises the breakdown between partiality errors and missed feasible matches. These update evidence for the same analytical questions without adding a new analysis design.

E5.justification: Both versions specify five random starts and 95% confidence intervals for image keypoint matching and retain the same uncertainty-reporting formats. Some interval widths change numerically, but no change in run counts, seeds, or statistical procedures is reported.

E6.justification: Reported OPGM-rs mean F1 changes from 57.8 to 57.7 on SPair-71K, 72.7 to 72.8 on IMCPT 100, and 60.9 to 61.0 on Pascal VOC. Table 4 and Figures 2–3 also receive limited numerical updates. Table 2 changes OPGM's IMCPT 50 mean from 71.9 to 72.1 while retaining its class scores. Overall rankings remain broadly stable; OPGM-rs revisions accompany the changed bias formulation.

T1.justification: Appendix A.1 corrects the general-mass cost offset from rho(||alpha||_1 + ||beta||_1) to rho(<alpha,mu> + <beta,nu>) and adds the missing construction extending any feasible partial plan to a balanced coupling in Proposition A.2. Appendix A.2 corrects an erroneous 'if and only if' in Lemma A.4 and restores rho in Eq. (22). These repair existing proofs without adding new theorems.

C1.justification: The abstract, introduction, and conclusion retain the same contributions: a weighted-total-variation formulation, an exact cubic-time assignment solution, and a learning architecture with partial matching loss. The scope of the central claims is unchanged.

C2.justification: Interpretations of matching biases, parameter sensitivity, efficiency, annotation ambiguity, noise, and failure mechanisms remain substantively unchanged in Sections 8.2–9 and Appendix B. Numerical revisions do not produce revised explanations or applicability boundaries.

D1.justification: Section 8 changes the advertised code repository from Gathika94/OPGM to Gathika94/OPGMrs. Appendix B explicitly limits the hardware statement to efficiency experiments. Hyperparameter grids and optimizer details remain unchanged; the PDFs do not establish a hardware change.

R1.justification: The cited works and substantive positioning relative to graph matching, partial transport, and assignment research remain unchanged. The references contain no added or removed works.

P1.justification: Edits are localized to the matching-bias explanation, appendix proof passages, and small wording corrections, including the duplicated AFAT-I name and 'entropic' terminology. The section order and overall narrative structure remain intact.

P2.justification: Figures 2–3 retain their panels, axes, and legends with revised plotted values. Appendix pagination changes: Tables 3–4 now interrupt the continuation of Theorem 6.2's proof, and Figure 3 moves lower on page 21. No figure or table is added or removed.

improvement.justification: The clearest gain is improved mathematical reliability: Appendix A corrects the general-mass cost identity and supplies the missing converse construction supporting transport equivalence, alongside smaller proof repairs. The empirical updates are limited and mixed. Existing discussion–table inconsistencies, including Appendix B's claim that OPGM has the higher Pascal VOC mean, persist. The net improvement is therefore useful but limited.
